resources.string: Listen to English

Only the English you choose to hear is sent to HaoHao’s server and Tencent Cloud to generate speech. No chat history or microphone is accessed. Audio stays in a private cache for up to 7 days (50 MB maximum). You can clear it or withdraw consent in My words.
